evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A categorical distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion by framing the owned/rented boundary as axiomatic.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Supplies a controlling classification — substrate as commodity, perspective as asset — that structures the factual terrain itself while arguing from that asserted logic.
